jobs.description:
﻿Korea Institute for Advanced Study, School of Physics Joint KIAS-KAIST
   Research Fellow Position in Particle Physcis The Korea Institute for
   Advanced Study (KIAS) and the High Energy Theory Group at KAIST invite
   applications for a postdoctoral researcher position within the
   KIAS–KAIST Joint Research Group. This position is part of a
   collaborative research program aimed at advancing theoretical
   high-energy physics through joint efforts between the two
   institutions. KIAS, founded in 1996 as the nation’s first research
   institute dedicated to the basic sciences, is located in Seoul and
   provides an excellent environment for fundamental research, offering
   continuous academic interaction and strong administrative support.
   KAIST, the leading university in science and technology in Korea and
   one of Asia’s top research institutions, is located in Daejeon with
   convenient transportation links. For more information about the two
   institutions, please visit https://www.kias.re.kr and
   https://het.kaist.ac.kr. Period of Appointment: Appointment after May
   2026 and within 2026(Contract term: 2 years) * The chosen candidate
   will be hired for an initial term of two years, with a third year
   possible, subject to performance & funding availability * The starting
   date may be subject to change * In case of the project’s closure
   during employment, the employment contract will be terminated
   accordingly. * KIAS complies with the 「EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
   AND WORK-FAMILY BALANCE ASSISTANCE ACT」.Women and minorities are
   strongly encouraged to apply. You can find more details below our job
   recruitment website’s notice
   https://jobs.kias.re.kr/ext/rec/rec_1001.do?ANNC_NO=REC202512230001
   Application Instructions Interested candidates should submit
   applications to the Academic Jobs Online (AJO) or KIAS Job recruitment
   website. The applications should include: a. CV b. Research Statement
   c. List of Publications d. Reference letters from at least two
   referees (three preferred) ※ All documents should be submitted by
   deadline for full application. Submission Deadline: March 31, 2026
   (Korea Standard Time, GMT+9) You can find more details below our job
   recruitment website’s notice
   https://jobs.kias.re.kr/ext/rec/rec_1001.do?ANNC_NO=REC202512230001
   For more information, please contact Ingyeong Shin(phys@kias.re.kr).
